Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football 4EVAYUNG FC Youngster Emmanuel Afful earns Ghana U-15 call-up for World Cup in Azerbaijan Source : JoySports 22 October 2026 7:37pm Audio By Carbonatix
4EVAYUNG FC’s rising star Emmanuel Afful has achieved a major career milestone after securing a call-up to Ghana’s national U-15 boys’ team.
The selection marks a proud moment for the Madina-based academy, highlighting its ongoing commitment to youth development.
​Afful joined the national squad as they departed Ghana on October 21, 2026, heading to Azerbaijan for the FIFA U-15 Boys’ World Cup and Festival, a global tournament designed to showcase the world's finest young talent.
​A standout product of 4EVAYUNG FC’s grassroots system, Afful has caught attention with his raw potential, electrifying pace, and dynamic style of play.
His selection provides a valuable platform to gain early international exposure and test his skills on the global stage.
​In Azerbaijan, Ghana’s U-15 side will compete in Group W alongside Uzbekistan, the Bahamas, Myanmar, Guam, and Kazakhstan
​Expressing his pride, 4EVAYUNG FC President and Bankroller, Mr. Seth Asamoah commended the young prospect:
​"I am delighted to see a young boy I took under my wing rise to this level. I hope he makes me and the entire staff of 4EVAYUNG FC proud."
​Afful’s national call-up further validates 4EVAYUNG FC’s core mission of identifying, nurturing, and elevating young talent to elite levels.
Located at the intersection of Madina, Ashaley Botwe, and Nanakrom, the academy operates a comprehensive football structure spanning U-15 and U-17 youth setups, Third and Second Division teams, and an innovative AI project designed to enhance club operations and player development.
​The milestone follows recent international transfers for the club.
Earlier this month, 4EVAYUNG FC successfully facilitated the move of two players, Seth Ziyaba and David Williams, to Maltese outfit Luqa St. Andrew’s FC, where both are currently settling in well.
